sections.overview:
Intro_to_marketing_course_content is a business automation skill designed to deliver foundational marketing course material. This skill is categorized under marketing and provides structured introductory content for learning core marketing principles. It is maintained by owner 780Noman and serves as an educational resource within automated business workflows.
Onboarding new team members with marketing fundamentals
Automating delivery of introductory marketing training materials
Providing standardized marketing education across organizations
Supporting self-paced learning within business automation systems
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/780Noman/Intro_to_marketing_course_content`
